title: Two sessions: remember and revisit
description: Session 1 has errors; session 2 starts fresh. Checks that the tutor carries learner history forward (the 除了…还… pattern from before, today's mistakes) and measures the cost of doing so.

checks: Before the learner's message containing 除了…还…, the tutor asked a natural question that invites the 除了…还… pattern without naming it or showing its formula.

Across this session, the tutor creates a natural chance to reuse a pattern the learner got wrong in the previous session (time words before the verb, or 比 comparisons), or refers back to the previous session.
